mentions.name: Piggy Toss
mentions.description: A video game adaptation of Pass the Pigs, the dice game where the dice are plastic pigs, designed for playing with friends. An early preview is available online.
mentions.audience: The goal is to play with friends
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building a video game adaptation of Pass The Pigs (the "dice" game where "dice" are plastic pigs).
